[[Decade Bow "Falling Star"]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[flatbow]] obtained from [[Ancient Anniversary Weaponsmith]] in [[Embark Beach]] during the [[Anniversary Celebration]] in exchange for 5 [[Proof of Legend|Proofs of Legend]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage|Piercing Dmg]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:Deals 20% additional [[damage]] during [[Special event|Festival events]]. No effect in [[PvP]].
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30
:Crafted in tribute to an enduring legend.

==Skin==
Uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Ivory Bow]] [[dye]]d black.

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as the "+20% damage during Festival Events" mod does not exist outside the unique Decade weapons.

==Notes==
* [[Auto attack]] arrows shot from this bow leave a stream of sparks behind. [[Preparation]]s that affect arrow appearance override the trailed arrows.
*The inherent bonus damage during events is only active during certain events ([[Canthan New Year]], [[Anniversary Celebration]], [[Dragon Festival]], [[Wayfarer's Reverie]], [[Halloween]], and [[Wintersday]]).
{{anomaly|Unlike [[Decade Rod "All the World"]], [[Decade Rod "Antipode Alloy"]], [[Decade Rod "Undying Service"]], [[Decade Staff "Astral Pillar"]], [[Decade Staff "Underworld Pillar"]] and all non-Decade [[weapon]]s, this bow's appearance is not changed when the wielder is under the effects of a [[weapon spell]].}}

==Trivia==
*Introduced in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20150422|April 22, 2015 update]].
